Polar Bear’s Ice Lab

Age 4–5 YearsClass 31 · ScienceSkill Melting and states

The sun is shining on an ice cube — predict what happens, then hear the science.

Play the science game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · MELTING AND STATES

Polar Bear’s Ice Lab

The sun is warming a big ice cube! What happens when ice gets warm? Tap what you think — then hear the real answer!

The sun warms the ice cube. What happens?

Great thinking, scientist!

Warm ice melts into liquid water — the same water, just melted. Try it with real ice cubes!

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Predict-then-check is the heart of science. Ask for the prediction BEFORE tapping, then run it for real: an ice cube in a bowl by a sunny window, checked every hour.

Illustration note: A prediction set-up: the child commits to an answer first, and the say-line gives the real result — warm ice melts into liquid water.

Prefer paper? The Polar Bear’s Ice Lab worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
